$comment: The catalog holds DIRECT cost (labor + material). A quoted price adds overhead, profit, contingency, material sales tax and permit fees on top. These profiles are the defaults an estimate starts from; per-job overrides belong in the estimate, not here.

profiles.name: Handyman / Small Repair
profiles.description: Single-trade work, low fixed overhead, priced close to direct cost.

profiles.name: General Contractor
profiles.description: Multi-trade remodel with supervision, insurance and warranty reserve. The default for packaged scopes.

profiles.name: Design-Build / Premium
profiles.description: Design, permitting, project management and selections carried in house.

profiles.name: Insurance Restoration
profiles.description: Carrier work priced at direct cost with a standard 10 and 10 overhead-and-profit split.
